app_update_body: Reloads the app in a second. Nothing you logged is lost.
app_update_after_workout: It installs after you finish this workout.
sync_failed_hint: The server didn’t accept some changes. They’re kept on this device.
sync_offline_hint: Offline. Everything you log is saved on this device.

match.countPlural=one: {count} change saved on this device, waiting for a connection
match.countPlural=other: {count} changes saved on this device, waiting for a connection

error_validation_failed: Some of that didn’t look right. Check and try again.
error_unauthorized: Signed out. Sign in again any time to pick up where you left off.
error_internal_server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Your data on this device is safe.
error_network: No connection. Try again when you’re connected.
auth_sign_in_title: Sign in to keep your log
auth_offline_body: Signing in needs a connection the first time. After that, workouts log offline.
auth_error_user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth_error_weak_password: That password is too easy to guess. Try a longer one.
auth_error_email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email first, then sign in.
auth_error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth_error_owner_has_unsynced: This device still has changes from {email} that haven’t synced. Sign in as {email} to sync them first, or sign out from Me › Account to discard them.
auth_confirm_email_body: We sent a link to confirm your email. Open it, then sign in here.
auth_example_hint: Log a set in one tap and always see what you lifted last time.
reauth_body: Sign in again to sync. Everything you log stays on this device.
account_signed_in_with_email: Signed in with email and password
account_sign_out_sub: Your data stays on the server; this device forgets it.
sign_out_synced: Everything is synced. Sign in again any time to pick up where you left off.

match.countPlural=one: {count} change on this device hasn’t reached the server yet. Signing out now would lose it.
match.countPlural=other: {count} changes on this device haven’t reached the server yet. Signing out now would lose them.

plans_library_not_downloaded: The exercise list hasn’t downloaded yet. It loads by itself once you’re connected.
home_no_routine_body: Add the routine you already follow, or pick a program. You can also just start logging.
log_empty: No exercises yet. Add your first one and start logging.
log_unsupported: Logging time and distance isn’t available yet.

match.countPlural=one: {count} set logged. Everything is saved on this device.
match.countPlural=other: {count} sets logged. Everything is saved on this device.

log_finished: Workout finished. It syncs when you’re online.
history_empty_body: Finished workouts land here, newest first. Your first one is a tap away.
history_not_found: This workout isn’t on this device.
plans_no_routine_body: Type in the routine you already follow, or start from a program.
routine_active_hint: Today follows the active routine’s days in order.
routine_session_body: Changes apply from your next session. Logged workouts keep the numbers they had.
routine_reorder_days_hint: Drag the handle to change the order. Today follows it.
routine_delete_hint: Past workouts stay in your history.
routine_delete_body: Its days and exercise settings go. Workouts you already logged stay in History.
routine_needs_network: Changing a routine needs a connection. You can still view it offline.
routine_new_days: How many days does it have?
routine_new_days_hint: Days are named Day 1, Day 2… for now. Rename them as you add exercises.
routine_new_active_hint: Today will offer its days in order.
routine_new_note: Have it on a screenshot or a note? Type it in here for now; importing from a photo comes later.
routine_new_created: Created {name}. Add the exercises for Day 1.
day_empty: No exercises yet. Add the first one you do on this day.
day_reorder_hint: Drag the handle to reorder. Tap an exercise for sets, reps and rest.
day_start_weight_note: Starting weight is only what you type here. The app never guesses one for an exercise you haven’t logged.
day_draft_note: Not saved yet: the day is added to {routine} when you tap Done. Going back discards it.
day_remove: Remove this day from the routine
day_remove_last_hint: A routine needs at least one day. Delete the routine instead.
day_exercise_added: Added {name}. Tap it to set reps and rest.
ex_rep_help_weight: Hit the top on every set and you’ll get a nudge to go up. Fall under the bottom and you’ll get a back-off.
ex_rep_help_added: Hit the top on every set and you’ll get a nudge to add reps or strap on weight.
ex_rep_help_reps: Hit the top on every set and you’ll get a nudge to add reps or hold a weight.
ex_time_help: Type 45 for 0:45, or 130 for 1:30. Reach the top on every set and you’ll get a nudge to go longer.
ex_start_last: Last time: {weight} kg on {date}. Your next session starts from that, so you can leave this empty.
ex_start_none: No history for this exercise. Leave empty to log your first set by feel; the app won’t suggest a number.
ex_warmup_hint: Suggests 50% × 8, 70% × 5, 85% × 2 before the first working set.
sort_picked: {name} picked up, position {n} of {total}. Arrow keys to move, Space to drop.
error_conflict: That clashes with a change already saved. Try again.
error_bad_request: Some of that didn’t look right. Check and try again.

match.countPlural=one: Its {count} exercise goes with it. Past workouts stay in History.
match.countPlural=other: Its {count} exercises go with it. Past workouts stay in History.

home_before_start_repeat: Nothing to change. Numbers start from last time.
home_before_start_first: First time on this day. Log each first set by feel.
home_freestyle_body: An empty session. Add exercises as you go.
home_days_label: Routine days. Swipe to choose another day
home_no_active_body: Pick an active routine in Plans to start its days here.
plans_next_hint: Days run in this order; start any of them whenever you like.
home_plan_deload: Feeling run down? Plan a lighter week
sug_all_top: All {count} sets hit {top} reps last time.
sug_all_top_after_name: all {count} sets hit {top} reps last time.
sug_top_again: {top} on every set again. Nice. Ready to go up?
sug_how_weight: Time to add weight or reps, your call.
sug_how_weight_today: Add weight or reps today, your call.
sug_how_added_weight: Add reps or strap on some weight, your call.
sug_how_reps: Add reps or hold a weight, your call.
sug_how_time: Time to go a little longer.
sug_why_all_top: Every working set reached the top of your {range} range.
sug_why_top_again: Second session in a row at the top of {range}.
backoff_under_min: That set was {reps} reps, under your {min} minimum.
backoff_min_all_out: {reps} reps with nothing left, right at your {min} minimum.
backoff_under_min_after_pr: New best, nice. {reps} reps is under your {min} minimum, though.

match.n=1: for the last set to stay in your rep range.
match.n=*: for the last {n} sets to stay in your rep range.

match.n=1: for the last set and keep your form tight.
match.n=*: for the last {n} sets and keep your form tight.

match.n=1: for the last set so it doesn’t fall short.
match.n=*: for the last {n} sets so they don’t fall short.

hint_topped_out: You topped out on every set last time.
hint_transition: Weights changed across sets last time. Match them set by set.
hint_one_short_weight: One set came up short. Hit {top} on all {count} and it’s time to go heavier.
hint_one_short_reps: One set came up short. Get all {count} to {top}.
hint_build_weight: Stay at {weight} kg and build to {top} reps a set.
progress_offline_body: Charts are worked out from your synced workouts. They load as soon as you’re back online.
progress_empty_body: Charts fill in as you log. One finished workout is enough to start.
progress_sets_sub: Counts sets, not kilos, so every exercise compares fairly. A helper muscle gets half a set.
progress_sets_so_far: {sets} sets so far; the week runs Monday to Sunday.
progress_frequency_month_sub: Finished workouts over the last 12 months.
progress_chart_empty: Nothing logged in this range yet.
progress_e1rm_sub: Best set each session, Epley. Only sets logged the same way are compared.
progress_e1rm_none: Log a weight × reps exercise to see its estimated 1RM.
body_offline_body: Your measurements are stored with your account. They load as soon as you’re back online.
body_needs_network: Saving a measurement needs a connection. Try again when you’re online.
body_one_entry: One entry so far. Add another to see a line.
body_value_out_of_range: That doesn’t look like a {name} in {unit}. Check the unit.
body_nothing_yet_hint: Weigh in at the same time of day for a cleaner line.
body_tap_to_edit: Tap an entry to fix the number or the time.
